focus: future-facing uptake can change because the world makes a positive future imaginable, achievable, or emotionally rewarding rather than because the underlying reciprocity norm improved
future-facing urgency can either mobilize or suppress action depending on coping scaffolds, agency, and efficacy-based hope rather than on distress intensity alone
implementor_warning: Do not treat future-facing motivation as evidence about a norm until the world publishes whether it changed imagination, achievability, emotional payoff, distress scaffolding, and delayed follow-up semantics.
